jobs.title: Data Scientist Intern - 2027
jobs.description: Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking highly motivated full-time students to join our Data Science Summer Internship Program. Data is a cornerstone of HRT’s trading strategies, serving as the raw fuel that powers research, automated trading, and risk management. While Algorithm Developers focus on statistical modeling and Software Engineers focus on the systems that power our trading, HRT Data Scientists focus on extracting useful information from the vast volume of data available in the world. Data Scientists are responsible for normalizing and validating vendor data, extracting features from quantitative and textual data, applying rigorous quality checks, and investigating methodologies for providing the highest quality data for research and trading. What to Expect A hands-on introduction to data, modeling, and engineering practices in the algorithmic trading industry Independent data investigation projects in Python using open-source libraries such as pandas and polars Opportunities to learn all about HRT s research and trading infrastructure, even in areas you may not be working in directly Technical project work and mentorship, with the opportunity to gain a deeper understanding of global financial markets Plenty of opportunities to connect with fellow interns, participate in team events, and explore the unique culture, food, and experiences that make each HRT office location and cities special Qualifications You are a full-time student pursuing a degree in a STEM field — a computer science background is not required Programming experience with Python at the level of “Python for Data Analysis” by Wes McKinney A curiosity for working with data and finding insights  Independent data projects, kaggle competitions, and such are a plus Exceptional attention to detail Strong communication skills We offer a weekly base salary offer in addition to a competitive signing bonus, company-paid housing, meals, and other perks. New York: Weekly base salary of 5,800 USD L

jobs.description: DATA SCIENTIST (H/F) STAGE MASTER II - 6 mois Rejoignez le Groupe INTESCIA, leader de la Business Intelligence en Europe ! Qui sommes-nous ? Chez Intescia, nous transformons la donnée en levier de croissance. Leader européen de la Data Intelligence, nous opérons le portefeuille de données et de solutions le plus complet du marché pour aider les entreprises à détecter plus vite les opportunités, mieux comprendre leurs marchés et décider avec impact. Présents en France, en Espagne, en Italie et en Belgique, nous réalisons plus de 75 M€ de chiffre d'affaires et figurons parmi les 50 plus grands acteurs de l'industrie du logiciel et de la data en France. Au quotidien, des milliers d'entreprises s'appuient sur nos solutions pour accélérer leur business. Contexte du stage Les LLMs (Large Language Model) sont des outils efficaces, rapides à prendre en main et généralistes, ce qui en fait un choix technique facile pour une grande partie des projets de traitement du langage naturel. Ils ont supplanté une partie des algorithmes de Data Science plus « classiques ». Cependant, ils ne sont pas exempts de défauts. Ils sont extrêmement coûteux en énergie, coûteux en eaux, coûteux financièrement et ils nécessitent d’importants investissements (création de Data Centers) pour être mis en place. Dans une volonté de contrôle des données produites et utilisées par l’entreprise (et plus largement de toutes données privées), il est important de garantir que les données traitées soient protégées, ce que l’usage de certains LLMs ne garantit pas. Nous venons par ailleurs de vivre en France, une série de canicules les plus importantes de ces dernières décennies, avec des records de température dans de nombreuses villes françaises. Il est nécessaire de prendre des actions pour aller vers des technologies plus sobres en énergie. Par ailleurs, le monde de l’IA connaît une période d’incertitude, avec une course effrénée vers des modèles généralistes de plus en plus gros et de plus en plus glouton

jobs.description: Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. About the role The MLOps team at Gravis builds the data flow that turns raw recordings from our autonomous earthmoving machines (LiDAR point clouds, camera images, GNSS positions and hydraulic signals) into clean, searchable, training-ready datasets for our autonomy models. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer – Models in Production (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Anyone can train a model in a notebook these days. Getting it into production, keeping it accurate month after month and turning its output into decisions people actually make is a different story. That's the job. For a renowned automotive manufacturer in Munich, we are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer who builds models that matter for a premium brand. You work with structured and unstructured data, take models all the way into production and make sure they keep delivering. Your results shape strategic decisions and the experience of customers who expect nothing less than premium. What makes this role different You don't build models that end up in a slide deck. You own them end to end, from the raw data to the deployed model to the insight a decision maker acts on. One client, one location, one team in Munich, with direct access to the people who use your work. And you are the person who brings machine learning into the business. You explain what a model can and cannot do, teach colleagues how to use it and help them ask better questions of their data. Degree or not, what counts is what you have built. If you have a proven track record of shipping machine learning applications, for example in open source, that is as valuable to us as a degree. The goal is ambitious. Move machine learning out of experiments and into the decisions a premium brand makes every day, from strategy to the experience of its customers. jobs.title: Machine Learning & AI Internship
jobs.description: WHY this position is important Pennylane builds the financial management and accounting platform used by SMEs and accounting firms in France, Germany and Spain. As a product-led company, we invest first in the product, and AI is now at the core of it. The ML & AI team (about thirty people in Paris, part of the Data organisation) builds the AI inside the product. Its first priority is Autopilot : automated accounting production with the accountant in control. Autopilot reads documents, books entries, matches bank transactions, reviews client files and prepares VAT returns with as little human intervention as possible. These tasks raise real ML problems. Answers must be exact, every client is different, accounting constraints can be checked automatically, and we have millions of real examples corrected by accountants. This internship is a chance to work on one of these problems with real data, real users and a direct path to production. HOW you will contribute You will join the ML & AI team, within a Tech organisation of more than 400 people. You will work on one main topic for the whole internship, protected from day-to-day work, with a dedicated tutor. Every topic follows the same path: Evaluation first : in the first weeks, you agree with your tutor on a frozen evaluation set and the metrics that matter. A baseline in production : you ship a simpler first version that the team can put into production, around months 1 to 3. Then go further : you improve it and explore more advanced approaches. Research topics are designed to lead to a publishable result. You will own the topic end to end: understanding the problem with accountants and product teams, defining success metrics, building, measuring and presenting your results. Topics for 2027 Here is an overview of the topics we want to staff in 2027. We agree on the final topic and your tutor with you.
